1070|8a3dd721.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|8a3dd721.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lass, then mark me--you've found it!

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11406|5d01ce11.name: High Priest Rohan
11406|5d01ce11.text: I hope the Light is with you, $N. Is there anything I can do for you today?

11406|8fca8484.name: High Priest Rohan
11406|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1275|fe52f4ea.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1314|0624ab70.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2485|6e89a35a.name: Larimaine Purdue
2485|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

274781|3804779b.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

274781|e946e3b5.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|e946e3b5.text: Ah, nothing better than a $c to cure what ails ye.  Of course a nice tall pint cures a lot of what ails ye too, but I don't think Braenna Flintcrag teaches brewing.  I guess ye'll have to settle for some $c training over in the Hall of Mysteries instead.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

342|02f7ab1f.name: Martie Jainrose
342|02f7ab1f.text: Hail, ARLANA!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3518|fe52f4ea.name: Thomas Miller
3518|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

376|8fca8484.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

376|bab8ec77.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|26f5a1f4.name: Verner Osgood
415|26f5a1f4.text: Hey ma'am, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5480|08830bac.name: Ilsa Corbin
5480|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5480|7a171557.name: Ilsa Corbin
5480|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5497|8fca8484.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5498|8fca8484.name: Elsharin
5498|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5498|9c6df40b.name: Elsharin
5498|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5567|3a20317a.name: Sellandus
5567|3a20317a.text: A fine display of worthiness. Your instruction may now continue.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|769875cb.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|769875cb.text: You are gonna want to head over to Old Town and drop by the Protective Hide if you are lookin' to learn skinning.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1078-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1078-accept.text:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
1078-accept.title: Retrieval for Mauren

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

11-accept.name: Deputy Rainer
11-accept.text:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11-accept.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
11-complete.text: I see you've been busy!  You have our thanks, $N.
11-complete.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

114-complete.name: Maybell Maclure
114-complete.text:
Oh...my!  I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

Thank you, $N.  I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

And for you... please take this.
114-complete.title: The Escape

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-accept.name: Verner Osgood
118-accept.text:
I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
118-accept.title: The Price of Shoes

118-complete.name: Smith Argus
118-complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
118-complete.title: The Price of Shoes

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-accept.name: Smith Argus
119-accept.text:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
119-accept.title: Return to Verner

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

120-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
120-accept.text:
These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. 

Now make haste!
120-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

124-complete.name: Verner Osgood
124-complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.
124-complete.title: A Baying of Gnolls

125-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
125-accept.text:
I could really use a hand here, $N.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

Retrieve my toolbox, $N, and I'll make it worth your while.
125-accept.title: The Lost Tools

125-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
125-complete.text: Excellent recovery, $N!  I never thought I'd see these tools again.
125-complete.title: The Lost Tools

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

126-accept.name: Verner Osgood
126-accept.text:
$N, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
126-accept.title: Howling in the Hills

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

127-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-accept.text:
Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
127-accept.title: Selling Fish

127-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
127-complete.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

129-accept.name: Darcy
129-accept.text:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
129-accept.title: A Free Lunch

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-accept.name: Wiley the Black
132-accept.text:
What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

Take this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
132-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-complete.text: Bah!  I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance.  But this information is crucial.  Good work.
132-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
145-accept.text: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
145-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

150-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-accept.text:
Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!

Hunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
150-accept.title: Murloc Poachers

150-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
150-complete.title: Murloc Poachers

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-complete.name: Scout Galiaan
153-complete.text: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
153-complete.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

154-complete.name: Madame Eva
154-complete.text: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare.  Here are some coins for those extra strands.
154-complete.title: Return the Comb

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

157-accept.name: Madame Eva
157-accept.text: Here is your thread, $N.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
157-accept.title: Deliver the Thread

163-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
163-accept.text:
Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $N. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
163-accept.title: Raven Hill

164-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
164-accept.text:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
164-accept.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
165-accept.text: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
165-accept.title: The Hermit

167-accept.name: Wehate
167-accept.text:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
167-accept.title: Oh Brother...

169-accept.name: Unknown
169-accept.text:
Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. 

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
169-accept.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

174-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-accept.text:
My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
174-accept.title: Look to the Stars

176-accept.name: Unknown
176-accept.text:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
176-accept.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
176-complete.text:
Hah!  Well done!  I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!

Here you are, $N.  And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
176-complete.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

180-accept.name: Unknown
180-accept.text:
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore

Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
180-accept.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-accept.name: Marshal Marris
19-accept.text: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19-accept.title: Tharil'zun

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

1920-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-accept.text:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the $C Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
1920-accept.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-complete.text:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, $N.
1920-complete.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-progress.text: Have you captured the creatures, $N?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
1920-progress.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1921-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1921-accept.text:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the $C District.
1921-accept.title: Gathering Materials

20-accept.name: Marshal Marris
20-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

Help rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.

And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
20-accept.title: Blackrock Menace

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-accept.name: Wehate
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

219-complete.name: Marshal Marris
219-complete.text: You have served the Kingdom well, $C.  Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs.  You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
219-complete.title: Missing In Action

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-complete.name: Salma Saldean
22-complete.text: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
22-complete.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

230-accept.name: Unknown
230-accept.text:
Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.

The book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.
230-accept.title: Sven's Camp

230-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
230-complete.text:
<Sven reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>

That shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death!  There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
230-complete.title: Sven's Camp

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

239-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
239-complete.text:
Marshall Dughan sent you, eh?  Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!

Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one.  I hope you can give us a hand.
239-complete.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

240-complete.name: Jitters
240-complete.text:
Aha!  Thank you, $N.  Those really hit the spot!

And here, please let me pay you for these!
240-complete.title: Return to Jitters

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

245-accept.name: Watcher Dodds
245-accept.text:
Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
245-accept.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

245-complete.name: Watcher Dodds
245-complete.text: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, $N, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
245-complete.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

262-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
262-accept.text:
I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!

Please, $N, you have shown your resourcefulness.  Please find that shadowy figure.  I must learn what secrets he holds!

I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm.  Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.
262-accept.title: The Shadowy Figure

262-complete.name: Madame Eva
262-complete.text:
Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge.  But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.

I can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
262-complete.title: The Shadowy Figure

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-accept.name: Madame Eva
265-accept.text:
Here is your book back, $N, and I bid you fortune with your search.  If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.

And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
265-accept.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
265-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  I sold this book a month ago to a shady person.  He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.

I hope that helps you...
265-complete.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
266-accept.text:
Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.

You might want to expand your search to the inn.  If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
266-accept.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-complete.text:
Oh yeah, I remember this book.  Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.

He left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something.  Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.

The first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...
266-complete.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

337-accept.name: Unknown
337-accept.text:
Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine.  Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.

It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
337-accept.title: An Old History Book

34-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
34-accept.text:
Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
34-accept.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
34-complete.text: Finally the menace is laid to rest!  Thank you, $N, you have done me a great service.  The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
34-complete.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-accept.name: Unknown
373-accept.text:
Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

It appears to be recently written and sealed.
373-accept.title: The Unsent Letter

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-accept.name: Shawn
3741-accept.text:
My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.

Could you find it for her, please?
3741-accept.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-complete.name: Hilary
3741-complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace miss $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
3741-complete.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

38-complete.name: Salma Saldean
38-complete.text: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely!  Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts.  And we're done!  For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
38-complete.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

386-accept.name: Guard Berton
386-accept.text:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, $N.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
386-accept.title: What Comes Around...

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

453-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
453-accept.text:
Good luck, $N.  I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.

If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
453-accept.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

6181-accept.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6181-accept.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181-accept.title: A Swift Message

6181-complete.name: Thor
6181-complete.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
6181-complete.title: A Swift Message

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

6261-accept.name: Osric Strang
6261-accept.text:
$N, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
6261-accept.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-complete.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-complete.text: A crate for Westfall, eh?  Have you been to Westfall before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
6261-complete.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, ma'am?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-accept.name: Thor
6281-accept.text:
For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.

If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
6281-accept.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-complete.name: Osric Strang
6281-complete.text:
Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

Well thank you, $N.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
6281-complete.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-accept.name: Dungar Longdrink
6285-accept.text:
The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
6285-accept.title: Return to Lewis

6285-complete.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-complete.text:
Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

Thank you, $N.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
6285-complete.title: Return to Lewis

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

64-accept.name: Jon
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind lady! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

65-complete.name: Wiley the Black
65-complete.text: So, Stoutmantle sent you?  Well, I owe him.
65-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-accept.name: Unknown
68-accept.text: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
68-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

88-complete.name: Ma Stonefield
88-complete.text:
Thank goodness!  That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop!  Thank you, $N.

Now, do either of these suit you?
88-complete.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

89-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
89-accept.text:
During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor.  We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.

Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt.  If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, $N, I'll make sure you're rewarded. 

Now let's get to work!
89-accept.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
89-complete.text: Great work, $N.  These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely.  We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
89-complete.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

91-accept.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-accept.text:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-accept.title: Solomon's Law

91-complete.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-complete.text: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N.  By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
91-complete.title: Solomon's Law

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

92-accept.name: Chef Breanna
92-accept.text:
Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-accept.title: Redridge Goulash

92-complete.name: Chef Breanna
92-complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
92-complete.title: Redridge Goulash

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92751-progress.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-progress.text: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
92751-progress.title: Detonation at a Distance

92909-progress.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-progress.text: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909-progress.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

95-complete.name: Unknown
95-complete.text: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
95-complete.title: Sven's Revenge

96137-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96137-complete.text:
Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.

Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.
96137-complete.title: Ira's Dagger

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding
